relations: A tipping red piece triggers adjacent dominoes to fall sequentially along the right-middle track.
The toppling wave travels down the ramp, flattening the lower pieces of the right curve.
The left stack leans and collapses, detaching white connectors that tumble onto the wooden floor.
caption: The video showcases a white plastic track-and-tower structure on a light wooden floor, loaded with rows of translucent colored domino-like pieces on ramps and tracks. On the right-middle track, a standing red piece and its dark-blue neighbors tip over one after another, sending a toppling wave down the sloping ramp toward the far-right curved track. As the wave arrives, the lower pieces of that curve tilt and lie flat while the upper arc of the rainbow stack remains upright. The bottom-right straight track of black, red, and orange pieces and the left ramp stay standing throughout this right-side cascade. Later, the left vertical stack of rainbow pieces leans leftward and collapses, detaching white connector pieces that tumble onto the floor near the left support. The camera stays fixed on the structure, and the left collapse is still unfolding in the final frames.
